note: Per-page tablet rules for states that have no tablet board to start from. Each op is applied to the phone body, in order. 'pair' puts two sections side by side as the tablet board does; 'columns' sets a grid's column count; 'fillTo' repeats a placeholder so a loading row has as many cells as the populated one; 'copyFrom' replaces an element with the same element from a tablet board, so a populated state shows the tablet's own data. 'styleFrom' names the page's tablet board, whose rules a generated tablet board gains where the phone board lacks them. This is hand-authored design, one entry per page. 'tabletBase' names, by state prefix, the tablet board a modal state's sheet is laid over on the iPad. 'css' adds native-only rules by state prefix. 'tabletCss' is the page's iPad design for a state with no tablet board of its own (longest state prefix wins): the iPad board leaves the holding 640 column and takes these rules; it also applies to the page's own tablet boards, and never to a phone board. A keyboard-up board is looked up by its own name. 'tabletOwn' holds ops for the page's own iPad boards (and the base under an overlay), by state prefix. A null 'tabletBase' entry keeps a specimen state (several examples on one board) off the overlay, so every example stays. 'ops' are hand edits ('appleButton' adds Sign in with Apple on iOS). 'keyboard' adds a keyboard-up board for a state with a field the cook types in. 'webOnly' lists states with no native screen, with the reason; they get no mobile board.

account.tabletCssNote: iPad 820 design (T32). Profile, Account and Legal sources: one 640 column left-aligned with the title at the 16 pt side (T31), as the iPad Profile board draws it, so lists and settings rows keep a readable length; a full-screen gate centres on the whole screen with its text capped at 560. Sign in and sign up: the form is one 560 column centred on the screen, the web 768 grouping without the card, since native sign-in is full screen. The session check fills the screen. Specimen boards keep one state under another. Over the Profile board, a bottom sheet is centred on the iPad and a dialog is a centred card over the first screen, as sheetPresentation.ts places them, instead of sitting below the page. A sign-in or sign-up form that fits on the screen is centred vertically (auto margins, so a form taller than the screen stays top-aligned), and each whole-screen example is one iPad screen tall. With the keyboard up (the …Typing boards) the form stays top-aligned above the keyboard.

appWide.tabletNote: iPad 820 design (T32). App-wide states at the iPad's full width with 16 pt sides: the sync and offline notices span the page, the backdrop screen fills the iPad's one screen, a crashed screen's notice centres on the whole screen, and a snackbar is at most 560 wide, centred above the tab bar. On the Recipes backdrop, New recipe sits in the search row, as the iPad Recipes board draws it, instead of floating.
appWide.cssNote: The recipe card's cover letter is drawn by RecipeCard at 32, off the 14/16/18/28 scale; the board sets it to 28 through react-native-web's class for that text style (r-r3d3ba). The component itself still owes the fix.
